leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a dynamic programming table to store edit distance computations
Initialize base cases for the edit distance algorithm
Implement the recurrence relation for calculating minimum edit operations
Manipulate string indices to compare characters during distance calculation
Apply the algorithm to compute edit distance between two given strings
Render the final edit distance value from the completed computation
Integrate the algorithm into a function that accepts input strings and returns their distance
